name: Ferdinand Lauren
headline: I turn messy processes into clear requirements.
positioning: Computer Science undergraduate at Universitas Lampung, working towards ERP functional consulting and IT business analysis.
availability: Open to internship, trainee programme and junior positions in ERP, enterprise systems and digital transformation.

process.label: Observe
process.note: Watch how the work is actually done, not how the SOP says it is.

process.label: Analyse
process.note: Name the actors, the handoffs and where the process leaks.

process.label: Define
process.note: Write requirements, states and rules a team can build against.

process.label: Verify
process.note: Turn expected behaviour into scenarios, then check them.
